note: توقع centrally means expectation/anticipation/hope. 'Wish, desire' is possible contextually but should not lead the entry.
مند is a productive suffix meaning possessing/having/endowed with, often equivalent to English -ful. 'With, characteristic of' is too vague.
بخش is a homograph: it can mean share/portion/gift and is also the verb stem/imperative of بخشنا meaning forgive/spare/give. The source omits the very common verb use.
proposed_english: share; portion; gift; forgive!; spare!; grant/give (verb stem, context-dependent)

note: وفد means delegation/deputation. An individual ambassador is سفیر; 'an ambassador' is not an appropriate direct meaning of وفد.
عشق centrally means passionate/deep love as well as passion/devotion. Omitting 'love' is a basic semantic gap.
تعریف means praise/commendation and also definition/description. The customs-tariff table sense is specialized dictionary noise for a general learner entry.
تیاری means preparation/readiness. 'Show' is erroneous source contamination.
حالیہ means recent/current/latest and is an adjective. The noun gloss 'participle' is grammatical source noise.
دعوت means invitation and also feast/banquet/meal; it can mean call/mission in religious contexts. 'Incantation' is not a suitable core gloss.
بری is a major homograph: feminine of برا = bad, while بَری can mean free/acquitted/innocent of a charge. The source gives only a grammatical cross-reference and no English meaning.
proposed_english: bad (feminine of برا); free; acquitted; cleared/innocent of a charge (context-dependent)

note: کمال is primarily a noun meaning perfection/excellence/mastery/wonder and can be an exclamation 'amazing!'. The source's adjective senses entire/extreme/perfect misanalyze the word.
proposed_english: perfection; excellence; mastery; wonder; amazing! (exclamatory use)

note: درجہ means degree/level/rank/class/status. The source is broadly correct but omits the common rank/class senses.
proposed_english: degree; level; rank; class; status; extent

note: تیسرے is the masculine plural/oblique form of تیسرا 'third' and functions as an adjective/determiner, not an unspecified closed-class item.
